source: hand-seeded from task 1D001C12 SPEC.md, Phase 2 (one command ships a task): the skills' manual commit and PR chain replaced by `crew-task.py ship`
summary: Shipping a task took three separate skills (`crew implement`, `crew commit`, `crew open pr`). `crew-implement` now ends with a Ship step: after the owner's go, the orchestrator runs the listed commands in the task's recorded worktree to stage, commit, merge the base, re-run the spec's tests, push, open the draft PR and mark the task done. `crew-task.py` is the task CLI that owns the task state (`.task-id`, PROGRESS.md and the gates such as `mark-done`).
defect: Shipping as a prose chain the model runs step by step is the wrong layer. Nothing records which steps finished, so after a stop (a conflict, a failing test, a lost session) the model reconstructs where it was and a re-run commits again or opens a second PR; `git add -A` stages secrets and large files unchecked; the tests run with no time limit and under the session's environment; and every skill that ships carries its own copy of the chain. History replaced the chain with one resumable command, `crew-task.py ship <TASK_DIR> --title --body-file`: it stages with secret and size checks, commits, merges the base, re-runs the spec's tests with limits, pushes, opens the draft PR and marks done, appending a `SHIP <step>` entry to PROGRESS.md per finished step so a re-run continues from the first unfinished one. The skills only call it.

after..cursor/skills/crew-implement/SKILL.md:
### Step 6: Launch worker

Dispatch `crew-builder` with the task directory and the approved SPEC.md. Each task's `Verify:` command runs after
the worker reports.

### Step 7: Ship

After every task passes and the owner says go, commit and open the draft PR from the task's recorded worktree, so
the owner no longer runs `crew commit` and `crew open pr` by hand. Run these in order and stop at the first
failure:

```bash
cd "$(jq -r .worktree "$TASK_DIR/.task-id")"
BASE=$(jq -r .base "$TASK_DIR/.task-id")
git add -A
git commit -m "$TITLE" -m "Co-Authored-By: $ATTRIBUTION"
git fetch origin "$BASE" && git merge --no-edit "origin/$BASE"
bash evals/test.sh -n auto        # the spec's `## Tests` commands
git push -u origin HEAD
PR_URL=$(GH_PAGER=cat gh pr create --draft --title "$TITLE" --body-file "$BODY_FILE" --base "$BASE") && echo "$PR_URL"
~/.agent/bin/crew-task.py mark-done "$TASK_DIR" --pr-url "$PR_URL"
```

If a step fails, fix the cause, commit the fix, and run the remaining steps again.

> Next: run `crew review` first if the change has not been reviewed.
